issues: Nothing to veto. The diff changes one hyperparameter, FINAL_LR_FRAC, from 0.0 to 0.05. It doesn't touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines, the prepare.py import or the evaluation call.
No bug that would make the result meaningless. A final LR of 5% of the initial value is a valid schedule setting.

The reported numbers agree with each other. The candidate scored 1.1124 against an incumbent mean of 1.1145, a 0.0021 improvement. z = 0.373 implies an incumbent standard deviation of about 0.0056. The standard deviation isn't given, so I can't recompute z on my own; I only checked that it is consistent with the other numbers.
With one candidate run and z = 0.373, the gain can't be told apart from noise, so the provisional reject is reasonable. Replicate runs would be needed before accepting it.
